findings.title: NFTBonfire maxPayout defaults to 0 (unlimited) and pause does not stop accrual, so an idle stretch, a deploy-wiring delay or a pause turns into one rate x D mint taken by the first burner; a cap applied reactively while burns are live is front-runnable and never binds

sources.role: root cause: uncapped default and accrual through pause
EMISSION-WINDOW-BOUNDARY mapping: accrual through a closed claim window; unpause tx is a back-run target
call-sequence facet: setMaxPayout on a live contract is front-run; PoC
primary text: corrects CODE-001 (pausing first DOES bind the cap) and sizes the impact
cross-reference only: Law-2 angle for spec-conformance.md (story names the cap as the idle-period protection but never requires it at enable time; follow-up deploy story missing)

findings.primarySource: ECON-001 (carries the corrected safe sequence and the sizing); CODE-001 supplies the PoC
findings.rootCause: maxPayout defaults to 0 = unlimited and pendingPayout() returns raw accrual when cap == 0 (NFTBonfire.sol:117-121); pause() blocks burn only and does not checkpoint or freeze accrual (L148-156); burn() is permissionless and reads the pot at its own execution time (L100-104). The cap only binds on accrual if it is in place before burns can run again.

instances.note: retroactive cap is front-runnable while burns are live (CODE-001)
accrual continues; first burn after unpause takes the whole paused-period pot (PATTERN-002, ECON-001)

findings.severityNote: Highest source label is PATTERN-002 potential-medium (mechanical pattern mapping). Every source that assessed impact (LOCAL-001, CODE-001, ECON-001, F-01-053) lands on Low: owner-triggered, no user principal at risk, and total emission is bounded by the owner-set rate x time (invariant_1_emissionTimeBounded holds over 512k forge calls + 581k Medusa calls). The harm is a missed forfeiture: (rate x D - intended cap) is minted as phUSD dilution instead of being forfeited. Severity-classifier to rate.
findings.correctionCarriedFromECON001: CODE-001's statement 'pausing first does not help' is wrong. While paused, burn() reverts EnforcedPause, so setMaxPayout/setRatePerDay cannot be front-run. pause -> setMaxPayout(cap) -> unpause binds the cap on everything accrued during the pause; only the pot standing when the pause tx lands can escape (via a front-run of pause()). The real hazard is: (a) the uncapped default itself; (b) capping while live; (c) unpausing, or enabling a rate before setAuthorizedBurner/setApprovedMinter have landed so burns revert and the pot grows, without a cap already set.
findings.attackVector: ratePerDay = 25e18, maxPayout = 0. A 14-day pause accrues 350 AM. Owner calls unpause() without setting a cap; a searcher back-runs it in the same block with burn(id, 349e18) and receives 350 AM (about $312 at $0.89/AM). Variant (CODE-001): with the contract live, the owner broadcasts setMaxPayout(10e18) on a 250e18 pot; a holder of any NFT burns first and takes 250e18. PoC: work/test/audit23/BonfireCapFrontRun.t.sol (test_CODE001_frontRunBurn_defeatsCap PASS, payout 250e18; control test_CODE001_capLandsFirst_payoutCapped PASS, payout 10e18).
findings.impact: Bounded by ratePerDay x D. No AM beyond the rate the owner configured is minted; the loss is the forfeiture the owner later intended (phUSD dilution of rate x D - cap). Cost to the winner: one NFT (marginal value about 0 for the ~772 idle unstaked V2 NFTs) plus gas.
findings.recommendation: Safe config (phStaging2 deploy follow-up, which does not exist yet): (1) setMaxPayout(rate x 1-2 days) BEFORE the first non-zero setRatePerDay, and enable the rate only after setAuthorizedBurner + setApprovedMinter; (2) to shrink a large pot: pause -> setMaxPayout(cap) [-> setRatePerDay] -> unpause, never setMaxPayout while live (or use a private relay); (3) setRatePerDay(0) preserves the pot and does not forfeit it. Optional hardening: revert setRatePerDay(nonzero) while maxPayout == 0, or checkpoint-and-freeze accrual on pause(). Note this sequence needs a working pauser (see DEDUP-004).
evidence: src/NFTBonfire.sol:117-121 raw accrual, cap only when != 0
src/NFTBonfire.sol:135-139 setMaxPayout checkpoints at the OLD max (0 => full pot stored uncapped; clamped on read by the new cap)
src/NFTBonfire.sol:148-156 pause/unpause do not touch accrual

findings.title: NFTBonfire pot is winner-takes-all per block on a value-blind gate (hold any NFT): any holder can copy or back-run a pending burn; minPayout protects an honest burner's NFT, and the story accepts the front-runnability
findings.rootCause: burn() pays the whole pendingPayout() to msg.sender on the gate 'holds >= 1 of any tokenId'; the payout is not tied to what the burner paid, and ordering within a block decides the winner (NFTBonfire.sol:97-112).
findings.severityNote: PATTERN-001 mechanical label potential-medium preserved here for the conflict rule. Assessed: Informational. Story-053 Notes call the pot 'trivially front-runnable' and supply minPayout as the remedy; minPayout reverts before the NFT burn (L101), so a front-run victim keeps the NFT and loses gas only. The only loss is to a user who passes minPayout = 0 (documented opt-out; C4 user-input mistake). Total emission does not change. Expected per-event MEV at the story-example rate is cents to a few dollars.
findings.impact: Redistribution only: who receives a fixed, owner-set stream. At 2.5 AM/day, bots burn once pot > gas (about 0.085 AM, about 49 minutes of accrual).
findings.recommendation: UI obligation (phlimbo-ui burn-button follow-up, not yet written): always pass minPayout = pendingPayout() - tolerance, never 0. No contract change.
findings.suppressionGuard: ECON-005 (AM = phUSD dilution, not opportunity cost).
findings.routing: QA/informational; UI obligation for the phlimbo-ui follow-up story.

findings.title: NFTBonfire is unpausable at deploy (pauser defaults to address(0)) and pausing NFTMinterV2 does not stop bonfire burns, so until setPauser + Pauser.register(bonfire) land, the global incident stop does not reach the burn/Antimatter-mint path and the pause-first cap sequence of DEDUP-001 is unavailable

sources.role: duplicate; record preserved verbatim in manual-review.json

findings.rootCause: pauser is unset at construction (onlyPauser L74-77 reverts for everyone until setPauser), and the global Pauser can reach NFTBonfire only after setPauser(globalPauser) AND Pauser.register(bonfire). NFTMinterV2.burn has no pause check (NFTMinterV2.sol:341-345), so NFTMinterV2's pause does not cover this path.
findings.severityNote: On its own this is story-documented (story-053 L102 'NFTBonfire's own pause is the only stop'; L21/L128 assign Pauser registration to the phStaging2 follow-up), which leans QA. It is kept as a distinct footgun because of the interaction a competent owner would not expect: without a pauser, the only way to cap a large pot is setMaxPayout on a live contract, which DEDUP-001/CODE-001 shows is front-runnable, and an owner who pauses 'the NFT system' via the global Pauser leaves bonfire burns and Antimatter mints running. Flagged for review; severity-classifier to decide Low vs QA.
findings.decision: KEPT DISTINCT from L-04 and from DEDUP-001. Facet (a) 'NFTMinterV2.burn has no pause check' is the root of ledger L-04 674c799b2058 (open; 'Privileged mintFor()/burn() ignore global paused + per-index disabled flags') — sanitizer should reconcile that facet to L-04 (bump lastSeenRun, add NFTBonfire as a new consumer in the note) and must NOT re-file it. Facet (b) 'NFTBonfire pauser unset by default + register required' is a different contract, different fix (setPauser + register in the deploy story) and different root cause class, so it does not collapse into L-04. It does not collapse into DEDUP-001 either: different fix locus (pause wiring vs maxPayout), though the two compound.
findings.impact: During an incident the global Pauser does not stop bonfire burns/AM mints; the owner's remaining stop is setRatePerDay(0), which preserves (does not forfeit) the pot. No user funds at risk.
findings.recommendation: Deploy story: setPauser(globalPauser) and Pauser.register(bonfire) BEFORE setRatePerDay(nonzero); add both to the phStaging2 verifier. Document that NFTMinterV2 pause does not cover NFTBonfire.

findings.rearmTrigger: Re-arm 858e9e80 to Medium in phoenix-nft-staking when, over a 7-day horizon, ratePerDay x 7d x v_AM >= (nudgeSize x price - typical nudge pot) AND (maxPayout == 0 OR maxPayout x nudgeSize x v_AM >= the same bound). Live numbers (econ, v_AM about $0.89 at phUSD $0.947): BatchNFTMinter idx4 (0x068395, nudgeSize 40, price 18.32 USDS, qualifying cost about $733, pot <= about $366) => ratePerDay >= about 59 AM/day AND (maxPayout == 0 OR maxPayout >= about 10.3 AM). RatchetBatchNFTMinter idx7 (0x81896f, about $2,800) => thresholds about 4x higher. Story-example 2.5 AM/day is about 24x below break-even (about 165 days at 100% capture).
findings.recommendation: Route to phoenix-nft-staking: rewrite the 858e9e80 triageReason off 'no realizable value' onto the quantitative bound; attach the re-arm trigger to 858e9e80 and the shared 521c20ad watch; note the frozen mainnet BatchNFTMinter 0x068395 has no ledger entry of its own. Re-evaluate when the phStaging2 deploy story picks the live rate/cap.
